title: Breach risk assessment worksheet
description: A worksheet for the HIPAA breach risk assessment (45 CFR 164.402): the incident, the four factors with a finding and a rating each, a conclusion, and the notification clocks. An exercise aid; the privacy officer decides. Nothing here is legal advice.

discoveredAt.description: Date and time of discovery; the notification clocks start here.

summary.description: What happened, in two or three sentences.
examples: An employee opened the records of 14 patients with no treatment relationship. The audit log shows the access over three weeks.

factors.description: The four factors in order: nature and extent of the PHI; the unauthorized person; whether the PHI was actually acquired or viewed; the extent the risk has been mitigated.

enum: Low probability of compromise not demonstrated: treat as a breach and notify
